spec.claim_summary: Long BTC on the 4-hour Supertrend turning from downtrend to uptrend with an ATR stop, a 0.75R target, and exit on the opposite Supertrend flip.
assumptions: Assets mapped from 'BTCUSD' to Binance spot 'BTCUSDT' as the same market.
Entry compiled as close crosses_above Supertrend on bar close to represent change from downtrend to uptrend.
Exit compiled as close crosses_below Supertrend to represent change from uptrend to downtrend.
Supertrend settings not stated, so standard defaults ATR length 10 and multiplier 3 used for both entry and exit.
Stop described only as atr stop loss with no multiplier or length, so ATR(14) with 2x multiplier used as the concrete value.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: partial exit closing half the position at 0.75R; take_profit_r is omitted because the schema would exit the full position at 0.75R and truncate the runner, so the spec holds the full position to the opposite Supertrend flip.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: moving the stop loss to breakeven on the remaining half after the 0.75R target; the spec retains the original ATR stop for the whole holding.
Backtest period 2020-01-02 to 2023-01-05 recorded in claimed.period_start / claimed.period_end; engine tests over all available history.

evidence.quote: you enter into a long position
Once Supertrend changes from a downtrend to a uptrend, you enter into a long position.
Once Supertrend changes from a uptrend to a downtrend, you close the other half of the initial long position.
The stop loss will be defined by the atr stop loss

audit_majors: take_profit_r: Claim requires first profit at 0.75 risk/reward where half position will be closed; spec sets take_profit_r to null and holds the full position to the opposite Supertrend flip, omitting the partial target.
stop_atr_mult: Claim requires moving the stop loss to breakeven on the remaining half after the 0.75R target; spec retains the original ATR stop for the whole holding to the opposite Supertrend flip.
